fields.statement: At cacee34c, built go build -o $TMPDIR/rhiza-qa ./cmd/rhiza and used it in a scratch git repo with the run env unset. add evidence e1 --field bogus=x exits 2 with 'an evidence has no field "bogus" (known fields: command, head, observed, pr, result, statement, status, test, tests)', next 'rhiza describe add'; --json gives code usage; capability with zeta and alpha names alpha first; anchor says it has no fields; actor --field nickname refused; rhiza apply with weight=3 refused as writes[0] usage; api call add refused the same; set e2 --field bogus=x exits 2 naming known fields; nothing refused shows in change show. Known fields (intent umbrella, decision notes_quote, evidence observed/head) are accepted. After hand-editing the log so e2 carries an unknown field legacyx, show e2 lists it, set e2 --field test=t1 still succeeds, render and check pass. set --unset of an unknown name is allowed. make check passes on this checkout with RHIZA_* unset.

At cacee34c with a fresh build, every field the internal/op schema lists was exercised through the CLI where the leaf names it (intent statement+umbrella, decision statement+notes_quote, evidence statement/result/observed/head/test, capability statement, actor refusal listing agent, email, for, model, name, role, session) and accepted, while bogus on evidence is refused; the refusal messages print the sorted per-kind lists from internal/op/fields.go. make check (which runs TestEveryFieldInRepoLogIsKnown and rhiza check on this repo's own log) passes with RHIZA_* unset.
